claim_ceiling: Candidate design contract only; no type admission, browser validation, participant comprehension evidence, active telemetry or release.

acceptance: Walk through success and exception fixtures with role-specific permissions.
A user can find the next action after every failure state.
source_row.purpose: Give the participant role an explicit path, decision points and recoverable exits.
requirements: Every step has an actor, visible status, next action and required backend receipt.
Exceptions preserve the original attempt and evidence lineage; no silent reset or hidden score penalty.
Access policy and purpose are rechecked at staff and export actions.
source_row.title: Invitation through data controls
